proposal.summary: IBM Financial Transaction Manager 3.2.0 through 3.2.7 allows a remote attacker to use specially-crafted URL requests containing "/../" to view arbitrary files on the system.

AV.quote: An attacker could send a specially-crafted URL request containing "dot dot" sequences (/../) to view arbitrary files on the system.

C.quote: to view arbitrary files on the system.

proposal.recommended_next_step: Request reproduction details and proof-of-concept URL(s) showing the "/../" traversal and list of files accessible, and ask whether any authentication is required.

evidence_quotes.claim: Directory traversal via specially-crafted URL containing /../
